PluginData.Author: CometWorks
PluginData.Tooltip: Test only: puts a rigid body that is not in the world into a Havok remove batch
PluginData.Description: Test only, for tests/havok-batch-removal/rig.py of the Bugfixes plugin. A line "twice" or "removed" written to batch-probe.txt in the game's user data folder makes the probe batch the removal of a grid's rigid body the wrong way. It writes what it did to batch-probe-done.txt.
